m: śaibya mfn. (often written śaivya) relating or belonging to the Śibis, AitBr.
śaibya m. a descendant of Śibi or king of the Śibis, PraśnUp.; MBh. &c.
N. of one of the four horses of Viṣṇu, MBh.; Hariv.; BhP.
śaithilya n. looseness, laxity, Hariv.; R. &c.
decrease, diminution, smallness, weakness, relaxation, remission, depression (of the mind), unsteadiness, vacancy (of gaze), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
relaxation of rule or connection, W.
a: śaithilyaṃ [śithilasya bhāvaḥ ṣyañ] 1 Looseness, laxity, relaxation of rule &c. 2 Slackness. 3 Dilatoriness, inattention. 4 Weakness; cowardice.
